name: Justin Ahomadégbé-Tomêtin
contribution: A Beninese politician most active when his country was known as Dahomey.
legacy: More neutral was Fraternite, noting that this person, whose political might was extraordinary, was among the most feared politicians in Benin's contemporary history.

checks.lead: Justin Ahomadegbé-Tomêtin (January 16, 1917 – March 8, 2002) was a Beninese politician most active when his country was known as Dahomey. He arose on a political scene where one's power was dictated by what region of Dahomey one lived in. He served as president of the National Assembly of Dahomey from April 1959 to November 1960 and as prime minister and vice president of Dahomey from 1964 to 1965.
